about: The Imagery agent's input for the regression fixtures and the prompt-only eval cases: the Quillmoor demo brand (fictional, a finance brand, so faces are refused) with a signed-off win-back brief, its name taken out as code does. The palette words are colourWords() of the demo palette's hex values (tests/evals/regression.test.ts checks they still are). The brief's words are written for these cases; they are not a production brief.

brief.title: Plus, picked up where you left it
brief.story: January is when people look at their money again. A saver walks home along a quiet path at dusk, seen from behind, ready to take one clear step back to their budget and savings pots.
audiences: Lapsed customers (no order in 12 months): they know the app already and need a calm reason to come back in January.
channels: paid social: one calm picture with plain space for a short line
display: the same picture, cropped wide

doRules: Keep the benefit and the risk in the same place
dontRules: Use urgency or fear ("don't miss out", "before it's too late")
Shame people about debt or spending
